data.fund_name: Invesco India Large & Mid Cap Fund

data.investment_objective: To generate capital appreciation from a diversiﬁed portfolio of predominantly Equity and Equity Related Instruments of Large and Midcap companies. There is no assurance that the investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved
data.asset_allocation: Equity and Equity Related Instruments (Min. 70% Max. 100%) out of which: (a) Largecap Companies: Min. 35% and Max. 65%. (b) Midcap Companies: Min. 35% and Max. 65%. Companies other than (a) and (b): Min. 0% and Max. 30%. Debt and Money Market Instruments: Min. 0% and Max. 30%.
data.exit_load: If upto 10% of Units allotted are redeemed / switched-out within 1 year from the date of allotment - Nil.
